description: This file defines the DummyPaymentMethod class, a mock payment method used for testing purposes within the Goteo project. It extends AbstractPaymentMethod and provides methods for simulating payment gateway responses, including purchase, completePurchase, refund, and response generation.

classes.name: DummyPaymentMethod
classes.description: A mock payment method class for testing, which simulates payment gateway interactions without real processing.

methods.name: getGatewayName
methods.description: Returns the name of the gateway, 'Dummy'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the payment method, 'Dummy Payment'.

methods.name: getDesc
methods.description: Returns a description indicating this is a test payment method.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns the URL to the icon representing the payment method.

methods.name: getDefaultHttpResponse
methods.description: Generates a dummy HTML response simulating a payment gateway page if in simulation mode.

methods.name: purchase
methods.description: Simulates a purchase process by setting the gateway to simulation mode and returning a failed response.

methods.name: completePurchase
methods.description: Completes a dummy purchase, setting currency, retrieving request data, and sending a simulated payment request.

methods.name: refundable
methods.description: Indicates that the payment method supports refunds.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Performs a dummy refund, dispatching an event and returning a successful response.

methods.name: isInternal
methods.description: Indicates that internal payments do not increase raised amounts.
